title: NetworkPolicy extensions/v1beta1 is no longer served
summary: The Kubernetes Deprecated API Migration Guide states that the extensions/v1beta1 API version of NetworkPolicy is no longer served as of v1.16, which was released on 2019-09-18.

sources.title: Kubernetes 1.16: Custom Resources, Overhauled Metrics, and Volume Extensions (release announcement, 2019-09-18)

constraints: Keep the resource's behavior unchanged: the same name, namespace, labels, and spec semantics.

The replacement (networking.k8s.io/v1 NetworkPolicy, available since v1.8) can differ in required fields or field names from the removed version; read the NetworkPolicy entry in the Kubernetes Deprecated API Migration Guide and convert the manifest accordingly.

steps.title: Change the NetworkPolicy apiVersion
steps.instructions: Change the reported `apiVersion` to the replacement version (networking.k8s.io/v1 NetworkPolicy, available since v1.8).

steps.title: Convert fields the new version changed
steps.instructions: Apply the field changes the migration guide lists for NetworkPolicy, then check the manifest still expresses the same intent.

steps.title: Align other NetworkPolicy declarations
steps.instructions: Update every other manifest, Helm template, and kustomize patch or target that names the old NetworkPolicy API version, so the repository agrees.

verification.purpose: Validate the migrated manifests against the schemas of the target Kubernetes version.
Ask a cluster on the target version to accept the migrated manifest without applying it.
For a Helm chart, render it and validate the output.
